title: voice-simulator voice
description: A voice: a preset plus the head values that differ from it, per parameter group (docs/VOICE-PARAMETERS.md).

preset.description: Head preset that supplies the values the file leaves out (size 0.5).

accent.description: Accent the voice speaks with (docs/accents.md): a code, or a code with a strength from 0 to 1.

vocalTractLength.title: Vocal tract length (cm)
vocalTractLength.description: Glottis-to-lips length. Formants scale roughly with 1 / length.

pharynxRatio.title: Pharynx share
pharynxRatio.description: Fraction of the tract that is the vertical pharynx.

mouthWidth.title: Mouth width (factor)
mouthWidth.description: Lip corner distance; widens the lip opening.

lipThickness.title: Lip thickness (factor)
lipThickness.description: Length of the lip tube section and visual lip volume.

jawRange.title: Jaw range (factor)
jawRange.description: How far the jaw opens for open vowels.

tongueSize.title: Tongue size (factor)
tongueSize.description: Tongue volume; bigger tongues constrict more.

headWidth.title: Head width (factor)
headWidth.description: Visual skull width; in the 3D solvers it also moves the face around the mouth.

headHeight.title: Head height (factor)
headHeight.description: Visual skull height; in the 3D solvers it also moves the face around the mouth.

noseLength.title: Nose length (factor)
noseLength.description: Outer nose size; also lengthens the nasal tract slightly.

wallLoss.title: Wall losses (factor)
wallLoss.description: Viscous and wall vibration losses of the tract and nose (formant bandwidths): scales the boundary-layer loss and the wall resistance.

nasalCoupling.title: Nasal coupling (factor)
nasalCoupling.description: Scales the velar port opening, so the nasality of nasals and nasal vowels.

nasalLoss.title: Nasal losses (factor)
nasalLoss.description: Wall losses of the nasal cavity relative to a smooth round tube of the same area.

wallMass.title: Wall mass (g/cm²)
wallMass.description: Mass per area of the yielding tract walls: heavier walls lower the closed-tract resonance and raise F1 of close vowels less.

wallResistance.title: Wall resistance (g/(cm² s))
wallResistance.description: Resistance per area of the yielding tract walls: widens F1 of close vowels.

wallStiffness.title: Wall stiffness (g/(cm² s²))
wallStiffness.description: Stiffness per area of the yielding tract walls (tense or relaxed tissue).

lossShape.title: Boundary loss shape (factor)
lossShape.description: Boundary-layer loss of the tract relative to a smooth round tube of the same area: the perimeter of the real cross-section over that of a circle.

radiationBaffle.title: Radiation baffle (factor)
radiationBaffle.description: How much of an infinite wall the face is around the mouth (0 = free pipe end, 1 = infinite baffle): more radiates more low frequencies and lowers the formants.

subglottalLength.title: Subglottal tract length (factor)
subglottalLength.description: Scales the length of the trachea and the bronchi below the glottis, on top of the vocal tract length: longer lowers the subglottal resonances (source-tract interaction only).

subglottalLoss.title: Subglottal wall loss (factor)
subglottalLoss.description: Boundary loss of the trachea and bronchi relative to the vocal tract walls (soft walls and mucus): widens the subglottal resonances (source-tract interaction only).

incisorThickness.title: Incisor thickness (cm)
incisorThickness.description: Thickness of the incisor row along the tract: the length of the narrow channel between the teeth.

restGap.title: Incisor gap at rest (cm)
restGap.description: Gap between the incisal edges at rest with the jaw raised, the gap of close vowels.

sibilantGap.title: Sibilant incisor gap (cm)
sibilantGap.description: Gap between the incisors in sibilants and alveolar stops, with the jaw fully raised: a narrower gap puts the teeth further into the jet.

velarGap.title: Velar incisor gap (cm)
velarGap.description: Gap between the incisors in velar stops (the jaw is lower).

openGap.title: Open vowel incisor gap (cm)
openGap.description: Extra gap between the incisors of an open vowel (scaled by the jaw range).

backGap.title: Back vowel incisor gap (cm)
backGap.description: Extra gap between the incisors of a close back vowel such as [u] (scaled by the jaw range).

pitch.title: Base pitch (Hz)
pitch.description: Fundamental frequency of the vocal folds at rest.

tenseness.title: Vocal fold tenseness
tenseness.description: Pressed (1) versus lax and breathy (0) glottal pulses.

breathiness.title: Breathiness
breathiness.description: Breathy voice: more aspiration noise at the glottis and a longer open phase.

jitter.title: Jitter (%)
jitter.description: Random cycle-to-cycle variation of the glottal period.

shimmer.title: Shimmer (%)
shimmer.description: Random cycle-to-cycle variation of the glottal pulse amplitude.

glottalChink.title: Glottal chink (mm²)
glottalChink.description: Posterior gap left open through the glottal cycle, common in women: a darker, softer voice with wider formants.

foldLength.title: Vocal fold length (cm)
foldLength.description: Length of the vibrating vocal folds: about 1.5 cm in men, 1 cm in women and 0.7 cm in children (fold source only).

foldMass.title: Vocal fold mass (factor)
foldMass.description: Scales the vibrating mass of the folds. Heavier folds vibrate slower; the pitch control holds f0 with more tension, so they swing with a stronger first harmonic (fold source only).

foldStiffness.title: Vocal fold stiffness (factor)
foldStiffness.description: Scales the stiffness and coupling of the fold masses. The pitch control holds f0, so stiffer folds swing with a smaller amplitude (fold source only).

foldDamping.title: Vocal fold damping (factor)
foldDamping.description: Scales the damping of the folds: higher values need more pressure to start (fold source only).

glottalPressureCoefficient.title: Glottal pressure coefficient
glottalPressureCoefficient.description: Pressure coefficient of the glottis: the transglottal pressure is this times rho U² / (2 a²), Bernoulli plus the exit loss (source-tract interaction only).

breathinessRd.title: Breathiness pulse shape
breathinessRd.description: Change of the LF shape parameter Rd per unit of breathiness: a breathy voice has a longer open phase and a stronger first harmonic.

breathGain.title: Breath noise gain (factor)
breathGain.description: Gain of the breath noise of a breathy voice: the noise is gain × breathiness ^ exponent.

breathExponent.title: Breath noise exponent
breathExponent.description: Exponent of the breathiness in the breath noise: higher values keep a modal voice cleaner and leave a fully breathy voice alone.

aspirationLevel.title: Aspiration noise (factor)
aspirationLevel.description: Scales the turbulent noise generated at the glottis.

fricationLevel.title: Frication level (factor)
fricationLevel.description: Scales the turbulence noise at constrictions (fricatives and bursts).

lungPressure.title: Lung pressure (Pa)
lungPressure.description: Subglottal pressure of normal loudness: drives the air flow, the noise at constrictions and at the glottis and, with the fold source, the vocal folds.

oralCompliance.title: Oral compliance (cm⁵/dyn)
oralCompliance.description: Compliance of the walls and the air behind a constriction: sets how fast the pressure builds up in a stop (about 11 ms with an open glottis).

glottisVoiced.title: Voiced glottal area (cm²)
glottisVoiced.description: Mean glottal area of modal voicing: more lets more air through and less pressure reach the constrictions.

glottisOpen.title: Open glottal area (cm²)
glottisOpen.description: Glottal area of an open glottis in [h] and voiceless obstruents.

glottisBreathy.title: Breathy glottal area (cm²)
glottisBreathy.description: Extra mean glottal area of a fully breathy voice: more makes the breath noise stronger.

reCritical.title: Critical Reynolds number
reCritical.description: Reynolds number above which a jet becomes turbulent: higher values give less noise from a weak flow.

wallSource.title: Wall noise source (factor)
wallSource.description: Amplitude of the noise of the jet hitting the walls against that of the jet hitting the teeth (-15 dB).

strouhal.title: Strouhal number
strouhal.description: Strouhal number of the jet: the turbulence noise peaks near this times the jet velocity over its diameter.

chinkNoise.title: Chink noise (factor)
chinkNoise.description: Breath noise per 10 mm² of glottal chink: the air leaking through a gap that stays open is turbulent too.

fricationGain.title: Frication gain (factor)
fricationGain.description: Amplitude of the frication noise of a default voiceless fricative (relative source strength 1).

transientGain.title: Burst transient gain (s)
transientGain.description: Gain of the burst transient: the flow derivative at the release of a stop enters the tract as a flow source at the constriction.

articulationSpeed.title: Articulation speed (factor)
articulationSpeed.description: How fast articulators move between targets (coarticulation).

stressLengthening.title: Stress lengthening (factor)
stressLengthening.description: Duration factor of primary stressed vowels.

finalLengthening.title: Final lengthening (factor)
finalLengthening.description: Duration factor of vowels before a full stop; weaker punctuation lengthens less.

pauseLength.title: Pause length (factor)
pauseLength.description: Scales pauses at spaces and punctuation.

coarticulation.title: Coarticulation (factor)
coarticulation.description: How early articulators start moving towards the next sound (factor on all leads).

roundingLead.title: Rounding lead (s)
roundingLead.description: How long before a rounded sound the lips start to round and protrude.

velumLead.title: Velum lead (s)
velumLead.description: How long before a nasal sound the velum starts to lower.

rateMinimum.title: Rate exponent of the minimum
rateMinimum.description: Exponent of the speech rate on the minimum duration of a sound: 0 keeps the minimum at any rate.

rateStretch.title: Rate exponent of the stretch
rateStretch.description: Exponent of the speech rate on the stretchable part of a sound (above its minimum).

jawPosture.title: Jaw posture (cm)
jawPosture.description: Speaker habit added to the jaw channel: a wider gap between the incisors in every sound (negative: a closer jaw).

lipPosture.title: Lip posture (cm)
lipPosture.description: Speaker habit added to the lip protrusion channel: pushed-out lips lengthen the tract, negative values spread the lips (a smile).

larynxPosture.title: Larynx posture (cm)
larynxPosture.description: Speaker habit added to the larynx height channel: a lowered larynx (negative) lengthens the pharynx and darkens the voice.

tongueRootPosture.title: Tongue root posture
tongueRootPosture.description: Speaker habit added to the tongue root channel: -1 pulls the root back and narrows the pharynx, +1 pushes it forward.

jawArea.title: Jaw area change (1/cm)
jawArea.description: Change of the mouth and lip cross-sections per cm of incisor gap away from the gap the sounds ask for.

tongueRootArea.title: Tongue root area change
tongueRootArea.description: Change of the pharynx cross-sections per unit of the tongue root channel.

speedHeight.title: Speed of height (factor)
speedHeight.description: Speed of the height channel: divides its time constant and its lead, on top of the articulation speed.

speedBackness.title: Speed of backness (factor)
speedBackness.description: Speed of the backness channel: divides its time constant and its lead, on top of the articulation speed.

speedRounding.title: Speed of rounding (factor)
speedRounding.description: Speed of the rounding channel: divides its time constant and its lead, on top of the articulation speed.

speedRhotic.title: Speed of rhotic (factor)
speedRhotic.description: Speed of the rhotic channel: divides its time constant and its lead, on top of the articulation speed.

speedPalatalization.title: Speed of palatalization (factor)
speedPalatalization.description: Speed of the palatalization channel: divides its time constant and its lead, on top of the articulation speed.

speedLipAmount.title: Speed of lip amount (factor)
speedLipAmount.description: Speed of the lip amount channel: divides its time constant and its lead, on top of the articulation speed.

speedLipArea.title: Speed of lip area (factor)
speedLipArea.description: Speed of the lip area channel: divides its time constant and its lead, on top of the articulation speed.

speedTongueAmount.title: Speed of tongue amount (factor)
speedTongueAmount.description: Speed of the tongue amount channel: divides its time constant and its lead, on top of the articulation speed.

speedTongueArea.title: Speed of tongue area (factor)
speedTongueArea.description: Speed of the tongue area channel: divides its time constant and its lead, on top of the articulation speed.

speedTongueLocation.title: Speed of tongue location (factor)
speedTongueLocation.description: Speed of the tongue location channel: divides its time constant and its lead, on top of the articulation speed.

speedTongueWidth.title: Speed of tongue width (factor)
speedTongueWidth.description: Speed of the tongue width channel: divides its time constant and its lead, on top of the articulation speed.

speedVelum.title: Speed of velum (factor)
speedVelum.description: Speed of the velum channel: divides its time constant and its lead, on top of the articulation speed.

speedVoicing.description: Speed of the voicing channel: divides its time constant and its lead, on top of the articulation speed.

speedAspiration.title: Speed of aspiration (factor)
speedAspiration.description: Speed of the aspiration channel: divides its time constant and its lead, on top of the articulation speed.

speedGlottalClosure.title: Speed of glottal closure (factor)
speedGlottalClosure.description: Speed of the glottal closure channel: divides its time constant and its lead, on top of the articulation speed.

speedFrication.title: Speed of frication (factor)
speedFrication.description: Speed of the frication channel: divides its time constant and its lead, on top of the articulation speed.

speedSibilance.title: Speed of sibilance (factor)
speedSibilance.description: Speed of the sibilance channel: divides its time constant and its lead, on top of the articulation speed.

speedTrill.title: Speed of trill (factor)
speedTrill.description: Speed of the trill channel: divides its time constant and its lead, on top of the articulation speed.

speedLateral.title: Speed of lateral (factor)
speedLateral.description: Speed of the lateral channel: divides its time constant and its lead, on top of the articulation speed.

speedJaw.title: Speed of jaw (factor)
speedJaw.description: Speed of the jaw channel: divides its time constant and its lead, on top of the articulation speed.

speedLipProtrusion.title: Speed of lip protrusion (factor)
speedLipProtrusion.description: Speed of the lip protrusion channel: divides its time constant and its lead, on top of the articulation speed.

speedLarynxHeight.title: Speed of larynx height (factor)
speedLarynxHeight.description: Speed of the larynx height channel: divides its time constant and its lead, on top of the articulation speed.

speedTongueRoot.title: Speed of tongue root (factor)
speedTongueRoot.description: Speed of the tongue root channel: divides its time constant and its lead, on top of the articulation speed.

durationClauseFinal.title: Duration rule clause final (factor)
durationClauseFinal.description: Strength of the duration rule clause final: its factor is raised to this power (an added duration is multiplied by it), so 0.5 halves the rule's effect on a log scale and 2 doubles it.

durationNonPhraseFinal.description: Strength of the duration rule non phrase final: its factor is raised to this power (an added duration is multiplied by it), so 0.5 halves the rule's effect on a log scale and 2 doubles it.

pitchRange.title: Intonation range (st)
pitchRange.description: Semitone range used for stress, tones and intonation.

vibrato.title: Vibrato depth
vibrato.description: Slow periodic pitch wobble that makes the voice less robotic.

vibratoRate.title: Vibrato rate (Hz)
vibratoRate.description: Frequency of the slow periodic pitch modulation.

declination.title: Declination (st)
declination.description: Pitch drop from the start to the end of a phrase.

accentStrength.title: Accent strength (factor)
accentStrength.description: Scales the pitch rise on stressed syllables.

intrinsicPitch.title: Intrinsic pitch (st)
intrinsicPitch.description: Pitch difference between the closest and the most open vowel (real speakers about 1.5 semitones); 0 turns it off.

larynxPitch.title: Larynx pitch coupling (cm/oct)
larynxPitch.description: How far the larynx rises per octave of pitch above the speaker pitch (and falls below it); 0 turns it off.

outputGain.title: Output level (factor)
outputGain.description: Gain before the soft limiter; high values saturate like a loud voice.

micDistance.title: Microphone distance (cm)
micDistance.description: Distance of the microphone from the lips: farther is quieter and, with a room, more reverberant (3 cm keeps the plain lip output).

micAzimuth.title: Microphone azimuth (°)
micAzimuth.description: Horizontal angle of the microphone from straight ahead: behind the head the high frequencies drop.

micElevation.title: Microphone elevation (°)
micElevation.description: Vertical angle of the microphone above the mouth axis.

roomWidth.title: Room width (m)
roomWidth.description: Width of the room (used when the reverberation time is above 0).

roomHeight.title: Room height (m)
roomHeight.description: Height of the room (used when the reverberation time is above 0).

roomDepth.title: Room depth (m)
roomDepth.description: Depth of the room (used when the reverberation time is above 0).

roomRt60.title: Reverberation time (s)
roomRt60.description: Time for the reverberation to fall by 60 dB; 0 renders without a room.
